scenes.description: Fish of several sizes, bubbles, seaweed, a boat on the surface and, now and then, a whale crossing the deep water
scenes.reduced: Everything swims at half speed and fewer bubbles rise

scenes.description: Drops at two depths, ripples where they land and a distant bolt of lightning every few seconds at most
scenes.reduced: No lightning at all, slower rain

scenes.description: Flakes at two depths drifting down and settling into a bank along the bottom
scenes.reduced: Slower snow

scenes.description: Stars that brighten and fade slowly, a crescent moon and, now and then, a slow shooting star
scenes.reduced: Stars take twice as long to change, shooting stars are rarer and slower

scenes.description: Columns of characters falling in the theme's syntax colours, each with a bright head
scenes.reduced: Columns fall at most three rows a second and their characters are never swapped

scenes.description: A dark meadow with lights that wander and pulse slowly
scenes.reduced: Slower, longer pulses and slower wandering

scenes.description: Slow waves of colour across the top of a starry sky over a mountain ridge
scenes.reduced: The waves move at half speed

scenes.description: Flames whose rows take a new shape one at a time, each at most once every 0.6 seconds, embers that rise and a steady glow on the ground
scenes.reduced: Each row changes at most once every 1.5 seconds, fewer and slower embers

scenes.description: A calm sea to the horizon under a sun, with gulls crossing the sky
scenes.reduced: Slower swell and slower wing beats

scenes.description: The Zacess mark drifting slowly and bouncing gently off the edges
scenes.reduced: It drifts at half speed

scenes.description: A garden pond from above, with koi gliding on slow curves under lily pads, drifting flecks and a slow ripple now and then
scenes.reduced: Koi swim at half speed with still tails, fewer and slower ripples

scenes.description: A harbour town at night, with lamps on the quay, their long shimmering reflections, moored boats swaying at their masts, a lighthouse and a passing ferry
scenes.reduced: Masts stay still, the shimmer changes half as often, the ferry is slower

scenes.description: Paper lanterns rising slowly from a dark lake at three depths, each with a reflection that slides down the water as it climbs
scenes.reduced: Lanterns rise, sway and drift at half speed

scenes.description: Hot air balloons in three sizes lifting from behind three ridges of rolling hills under drifting clouds
scenes.reduced: Balloons rise and drift at half speed

scenes.description: A steam train crossing open country, with hills, hedgerows, trees, the track and a fence sliding past at their own speeds
scenes.reduced: Every layer slides at half speed and smoke puffs half as often

scenes.description: A log cabin in the snow at night, with a lit window, chimney smoke, pines and gently falling snow
scenes.reduced: Snow and smoke move at half speed

scenes.description: A tree in autumn colour dropping leaves that turn as they drift down and gather in a pile, with geese crossing now and then
scenes.reduced: Leaves fall at half the rate without turning

scenes.description: A flowering branch letting petals go on a breeze, down to a stream that carries them away, with a bird on the branch
scenes.reduced: Petals fall and float at half speed without turning, the bird looks about half as often

scenes.description: A night skyline where windows light and darken one at a time, a moon, a river and a train that crosses a bridge now and then
scenes.reduced: Windows change half as often and the train is slower and rarer

scenes.description: A banded, shaded planet circled by a ring that passes behind it and in front of it, with a moon on a slow 40 second orbit
scenes.reduced: The moon takes 80 seconds to go round

scenes.description: Stars joined slowly into named figures of our own, one group at a time, held and then faded
scenes.reduced: Lines are drawn at half speed and fade more slowly

scenes.description: A mug of tea with curling steam, books, a plant and a lamp, with rain or snow at the window
scenes.reduced: Fewer, slower puffs of steam and slower weather

scenes.description: A cat asleep on a cushion, breathing slowly, with drifting z's, wool on the rug and a night window
scenes.reduced: Breaths, the tail and the z's take twice as long

scenes.description: Seeds that sprout, grow and bloom over a season of about two minutes, with butterflies, before the bed starts again
scenes.reduced: The season takes twice as long and wings beat half as often

scenes.description: A grid of small pages with the Zacess fold, one tile changing colour at a time
scenes.reduced: Tiles change half as often

scenes.description: Ribbons of contour lines flowing slowly across a faint grid of dots
scenes.reduced: The ribbons flow at half speed

scenes.description: Twice the rain of `rain`, slanting in a strong wind under two rows of cloud, with a bolt of lightning every 5 to 9 seconds at most and never in the first five
scenes.reduced: No lightning at all, slower rain

scenes.description: A street where the water rises slowly past the doors and holds with a gentle swell, debris drifting along the surface and a warning sign going under
scenes.reduced: The water rises, swells and drifts at half speed and the drizzle is halved

scenes.description: A cargo ship on a grey sea that settles by the bow over a minute as its waterline creeps up past the portholes, then rolls gently while a lifebuoy drifts away
scenes.reduced: It lists, rolls and drifts at half speed

scenes.description: Riveted steel plates where rust creeps out from the rivets cell by cell to half the wall, darkening as it ages, with slow drips
scenes.reduced: Rust spreads and drips at half speed and each stage takes twice as long

scenes.description: Cables hanging from a patch panel that slowly wander, cross and knot into a swaying snarl with a warning tag
scenes.reduced: The cables tangle and sway at half speed

scenes.description: Potted plants on a sunny sill whose stems droop over, leaves dry and fall onto the sill and soil cracks
scenes.reduced: The plants wilt, sway and drop leaves at half speed

scenes.description: A road with signs, lamps and pines where a fog bank rolls in and the signs fade from view, glimpsed through gaps
scenes.reduced: The fog rolls in and drifts at half speed

scenes.description: A bridge over a flowing river with its middle span gone, girders hanging, the fallen span in the water, a barrier, a warning sign and a waiting car
scenes.reduced: The river and clouds move at half speed and fragments fall half as often

scenes.description: A cracked pipe dripping into a bucket that fills over a minute and then overflows into a puddle that spreads and holds, with a sinking pressure gauge and a wet floor sign
scenes.reduced: Drips come half as often and fall at half speed

scenes.description: A night skyline whose lit windows go dark one at a time beside a snapped power line, leaving a few candles and windows on their own power
scenes.reduced: The windows go dark at half the rate and the clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: Cars queued bumper to bumper before a stop line, cones and a signal stuck on red, with exhaust puffs drifting up
scenes.reduced: Cars roll in at half speed and puffs come half as often

scenes.description: A cliff edge crumbling into the sea, stones tumbling and splashing and a fence left hanging over the drop until the face reaches harder rock
scenes.reduced: Pieces break away half as often and fall at half speed

scenes.description: Cracked earth spreading edge by edge under a heavy sun, a dry riverbed whose last puddle shrinks away, a withered tree and drifting dust
scenes.reduced: The cracks spread and the puddle dries at half the rate

soundSets.sound: Soft bells with a little shimmer, the original tones
Warm wooden bars, short and round
Plucked metal tines with a gentle ring
A soft synth pad that swells in and fades out
Gentle 8-bit square waves, rounded so they never buzz
Slow glassy tones like a wet finger on a rim
